title: Tripwire + OTO Commerce Funnel
summary: Build a commerce funnel that sells a product — a tripwire checkout, a one-time-offer (OTO) upsell, then thank-you — taking real Stripe payments and landing a canonical order. Create by forking a template (funnel_template_apply — single-product-checkout / tripwire-oto / subscription-checkout), NEVER raw flow_create. Customise node copy with flow_update_node; edge operators are long-form (op:"equal", never "eq"); publish with live_mode=true; test in Stripe test mode (card 4242 4242 4242 4242 — OTO accept charges off-session, decline is a no-op). Read orders read-only via commerce_order_list/get/stats/export_csv (total_amount_cents is minor-units). You can author the whole funnel except creating the product itself — product creation uses the Medusa Admin UI today; the agent-native surface is coming soon. Use whenever the user asks to 'sell a product', 'build a checkout/tripwire/upsell/OTO funnel', 'set up a commerce funnel', or 'read my orders/revenue'.
